sql: SeLeCt o.OrderID , c.CustomerName ,e.LastName   FrOm dbo.Orders AS o inner JOIN dbo.Customers c oN o.CustomerID=c.CustomerID INNER join dbo.Employees AS e On o.EmployeeID=e.EmployeeID WHERE o.OrderDate>='2024-01-01' oRdEr By o.OrderID dEsC

select	d.OrderDetailID,	p.ProductName	,s.SupplierName, cat.CategoryName,o.OrderDate 
from dbo.OrderDetails d
	join dbo.Products p on d.ProductID=p.ProductID
	join dbo.Suppliers s	on p.SupplierID=s.SupplierID   
	join dbo.Categories cat	on p.CategoryID=cat.CategoryID
	join dbo.Orders o on d.OrderID =o.OrderID
where p.Price>10

SELECT c.CustomerName, o.OrderID, sh.ShipperName FROM dbo.Customers c LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID left join dbo.Shippers sh on o.ShipperID=sh.ShipperID where c.Country in('USA','UK','Germany')

with OrderTotals as(select od.OrderID,sum(od.Quantity) as TotalQty from dbo.OrderDetails od group by od.OrderID)select o.OrderID,o.OrderDate,t.TotalQty from dbo.Orders o join OrderTotals t on o.OrderID=t.OrderID where t.TotalQty>20

WITH CustOrders AS (SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS Cnt FROM dbo.Orders GROUP
BY CustomerID), BigCust as (select CustomerID from CustOrders where
Cnt>5) sElEcT c.CustomerName , c.Country FROM dbo.Customers c JOIN BigCust b ON c.CustomerID=b.CustomerID order by c.CustomerName

-- chained CTEs three deep
with L1 as (select ProductID, SupplierID, Price from dbo.Products where Price is not null), L2 as (select SupplierID, avg(Price) as AvgPrice from L1 group by SupplierID), L3 as (select s.SupplierName, l.AvgPrice from dbo.Suppliers s join L2 l on s.SupplierID=l.SupplierID)
select * from L3 where AvgPrice>15 order by AvgPrice desc
select ProductName,Price from dbo.Products where CategoryID in(select CategoryID from dbo.Categories where CategoryName like '%o%')and Price between 5 and 50

SELECT c.CustomerName,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID=c.CustomerID) AS OrderCount,( select max(o2.OrderDate) from dbo.Orders o2 where o2.CustomerID=c.CustomerID ) LastOrder FROM dbo.Customers c
select s.SupplierName from dbo.Suppliers s where EXISTS(select 1 from dbo.Products p where p.SupplierID=s.SupplierID and p.Price>40) and s.Country is not null
select x.CategoryID,x.AvgPrice from (select CategoryID,avg(Price) as AvgPrice from dbo.Products group by CategoryID) as x where x.AvgPrice>20 order by x.AvgPrice desc

SELECT c.CategoryName,	t.ProductCount FROM dbo.Categories c JOIN	(SELECT CategoryID, COUNT(*) AS ProductCount FROM dbo.Products GROUP BY CategoryID) t ON c.CategoryID=t.CategoryID ORDER BY t.ProductCount DESC
select City , Country from dbo.Customers where City is not null UNION select City,Country from dbo.Suppliers where City is not null ORDER BY Country , City
select 'customer' as Src, CustomerName as Name from dbo.Customers union all select 'supplier',SupplierName from dbo.Suppliers union all select 'shipper',ShipperName from dbo.Shippers
select e.LastName , count(o.OrderID) as Orders from dbo.Employees e join dbo.Orders o on e.EmployeeID=o.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.LastName HAVING count(o.OrderID)>=10 order by Orders desc , e.LastName

select year(InvoiceDate) as yr,Paid,sum(TotalAmount) as Total from Sales.Invoices group by year(InvoiceDate),Paid having sum(TotalAmount)>1000 order by yr;select count(*) as UnpaidCnt from Sales.Invoices where Paid=0
select   top 5   ProductName,Price   from dbo.Products   order by Price desc
selecT Top 10 pErCeNt With Ties p.ProductName,p.Price FROM dbo.Products p ORDER BY p.Price DESC

select	DISTINCT
	c.Country
from dbo.Customers c
where c.Country is not null
order	by c.Country
SELECT distinct p.ProductName FROM dbo.Products p JOIN dbo.OrderDetails od ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID WHERE od.Quantity>50
select ProductName, case CategoryID when 1 then 'Beverage' when 2 then 'Condiment' else 'Other' end as Kind from dbo.Products where CategoryID is not null
select InvoiceID,case when Paid=1 then 'settled' when TotalAmount>500 then 'big open' else 'open' end Status,TotalAmount from Sales.Invoices
select o.OrderID, case when o.ShipperID is null then 'none' else case o.ShipperID when 1 then 'Speedy' when 2 then 'United' else 'Federal' end end as ShipVia from dbo.Orders o
select CustomerName, Country from dbo.Customers order by case when Country='USA' then 0 when Country='UK' then 1 else 2 end , CustomerName
select CategoryID,sum(case when Price>20 then 1 else 0 end) as Expensive,sum(case when Price<=20 then 1 else 0 end) Cheap from dbo.Products group by CategoryID order by CategoryID
select * from dbo.vw_ProductCatalog where Price>15 ; exec dbo.usp_GetCustomerOrders @CustomerID=3,@FromDate='2024-01-01',@ToDate='2024-06-30' ;select count(*) as OrderCnt from dbo.Orders
SeLeCt v.CustomerName,v.OrderDate ,v.OrderID frOm dbo.vw_CustomerOrders v whERE v.Country='UK' oRDer bY v.OrderDate dEsc

-- top customers report
select top 10 c.CustomerName, /* total order count */ count(o.OrderID) as Cnt from dbo.Customers c /* keep zero-order customers */ left join dbo.Orders o on c.CustomerID=o.CustomerID group by c.CustomerName order by Cnt desc -- trailing note
select p.ProductName /* unit info follows */ , p.Unit , p.Price from dbo.Products p where p.SupplierID=1 /* first supplier only */
select CustomerName from dbo.Customers where ContactName<>'SELECT * FROM secret' and City not like '%DROP TABLE%' and Country='USA'
select 'ORDER BY is a keyword' as Note,OrderID from dbo.Orders where OrderID<5;select 'UNION ALL inside a literal' as Note2,count(*) as Cnt from dbo.Products
select ProductName from dbo.Products where Unit='it''s a SELECT box' or ProductName like '%and%'
select InvoiceID, case when Paid=1 then 'PAID -- do not UPDATE' else 'PENDING /* SELECT later */' end as Note from Sales.Invoices where TotalAmount>0

update dbo.Products set Price=Price*1.10 where CategoryID=(select CategoryID from dbo.Categories where CategoryName='Beverages') ; select ProductName,Price from dbo.Products where CategoryID=1 order by Price
select o.OrderID,o.OrderDate from dbo.Orders o where o.CustomerID in (select top 3 CustomerID from dbo.Orders where CustomerID is not null group by CustomerID order by count(*) desc)
select u.Name,u.Src from (select CustomerName as Name,'C' as Src from dbo.Customers union all select SupplierName,'S' from dbo.Suppliers) u where u.Name like 'A%' order by u.Name

with AllCities as (select City,Country from dbo.Customers union select City,Country from dbo.Suppliers) select Country,count(*) as CityCnt from AllCities where City is not null group by Country having count(*)>1 order by CityCnt desc

select ShipperID,ShipperName,Phone from dbo.Shippers;		SELECT	e.FirstName ,	e.LastName
FROM dbo.Employees e
WHERE e.BirthDate is not null ;
select   count(*)   as ProductCount   
from dbo.Products

select z.CategoryName,z.MaxPrice from (select c.CategoryName,y.MaxPrice from dbo.Categories c join (select CategoryID,max(Price) as MaxPrice from dbo.Products group by CategoryID) y on c.CategoryID=y.CategoryID) z where z.MaxPrice>30 order by z.MaxPrice desc
select c.CategoryName , s.ShipperName from dbo.Categories c CROSS JOIN dbo.Shippers s order by c.CategoryName

declare @minPrice numeric(9,2)=10 ; -- price floor
select ProductName , Price from dbo.Products where Price>=@minPrice order by Price ; select @minPrice as UsedFloor
select o1.OrderID , o2.OrderID as LaterOrder from dbo.Orders o1 join dbo.Orders o2 on o1.CustomerID=o2.CustomerID and o1.OrderID<o2.OrderID where o1.EmployeeID=4
select od.OrderID , od.ProductID , od.Quantity , sum(od.Quantity) over(partition by od.OrderID) as TotalPerOrder from dbo.OrderDetails od where od.Quantity is not null

select count(*) as CustCount from dbo.Customers ;with Recent as (select top 10 OrderID,OrderDate from dbo.Orders order by OrderDate desc) select r.OrderID,r.OrderDate,i.TotalAmount from Recent r join Sales.Invoices i on i.OrderID=r.OrderID
select p.SupplierID , count(*) as Cnt , avg(p.Price) as AvgPrice from dbo.Products p where p.SupplierID is not null group by p.SupplierID having count(*)>2 and avg(p.Price)<100 order by AvgPrice

select e.EmployeeID , sum( case when o.ShipperID=1 then case when o.OrderDate>'2024-06-01' then 2 else 1 end else 0 end ) as Score from dbo.Employees e left join dbo.Orders o on e.EmployeeID=o.EmployeeID group by e.EmployeeID order by Score desc
exec Sales.usp_MarkInvoicePaid @InvoiceID=7 ; EXEC dbo.usp_UpdateProductPrice @ProductID=12 , @NewPrice=19.99 ; select InvoiceID , Paid from Sales.Invoices where InvoiceID=7
SELECT C.CUSTOMERNAME FROM DBO.CUSTOMERS C WHERE C.CUSTOMERID NOT IN(SELECT O.CUSTOMERID FROM DBO.ORDERS O WHERE O.CUSTOMERID IS NOT NULL)ORDER BY C.CUSTOMERNAME

     p.ProductName   ,

  p.Price

 p.Price

with T as(select o.CustomerID,count(*) Cnt,max(o.OrderDate) LastDate from dbo.Orders o group by o.CustomerID)select c.CustomerName,t.Cnt,case when t.Cnt>10 then 'VIP' when t.Cnt>5 then 'regular' else 'rare' end Tier from dbo.Customers c join T t on c.CustomerID=t.CustomerID where c.Country<>'INSERT INTO nowhere' order by t.Cnt desc;select ProductName from dbo.Products where ProductID in(select ProductID from dbo.OrderDetails where Quantity>90) -- end of batch
